questions.question:
The speed of train D is 18 m/s. Find the total time taken by train D to cross the platform and bridge of length 250 m.

Note: Calculate the time taken by the train to cross the platform and the bridge separately.
questions.solution: Solution: Given: Speed of train D = 18 m/s Total distance travelled by train D = 200 + 160 = 360 m Time required to cross platform = 360/18 = 20 sec Total distance when train crosses a bridge = 200 + 250 = 450 m Time required to cross platform = 450/18 = 25 sec Total time = 20 + 25 = 45 sec दिया है: ट्रेन D की गति = 18 मी/से ट्रेन D द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी = 200 + 160 = 360 मी प्लेटफॉर्म पार करने के लिए आवश्यक समय = 360/18 = 20 सेकंड ट्रेन के पुल को पार करने के दौरान कुल दूरी = 200 + 250 = 450

questions.question: If the volume of the cylindrical tube is 4928 m<sup style="">3</sup> and its diameter is 28 m, then find the curved surface area of the cylindrical tube.
questions.solution: Solution: Given: Diameter = 28 m Volume = 4928 m 3 Formula used: Volume of cylindrical tube = πr 2 h Curved surface area = 2πrh Calculation: Radius = 28 / 2 = 14 m Volume of cylindrical tube = πr 2 h ⇒ (22 / 7) × 14 2 × h = 4928 ⇒ h = 8 m ∴ Curved surface area = 2πrh ⇒ 2 × (22 / 7) × 14 × 8 = 704 m 2 दिया गया है: व्यास = 28 मीटर आयतन = 4928 मीटर 3 उपयोग किया गया सूत्र: बेलनाकार नली का आयतन = πr 2 h वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2πr

questions.question: Speed of boat A travelling in still water is 15 km/hr. Speed of boat B is 40% of twice of speed of boat A in still water. A is travelling upstream and B is travelling downstream, find the time(in hours) for boats to meet if the river is 108 km long.
questions.solution: Solution: Given:- Speed of A = 15 km/hr Speed of B = 40% of 2 × 15 = 12 km/hr Formula:- Speed = Distance/Time Downstream speed = b + v Upstream speed = b – v B and v are boat and stream speeds. Calculation:- Upstream speed of A = 15 – v Downstream speed of B = 12 + v Since they are travelling in opposite directions, their speed will be added for relative speed. Relative speed = 15 – v + 12 + v = 27 Time = 108/27 = 4 hours दिया गया है:- A की गति = 15 किमी/घंटा B की गति = 2

questions.question: Rohit, Gagan and Shalu invested in a business. Rohit invested 1/2th of the capital for 1/2 time, Gagan invested 1/3th of the capital for 1/4 time and Shalu invested the remaining capital for whole time. Find the share of Shalu in the total profit of Rs. 150000.
questions.solution: Solution: Given Rohit invested 1/2 th of the capital for time = 1/2 time Gagan invested 1/3 th of the capital for time = 1/4 time Total Profit earned = Rs. 150000 Calculation Ratio of share profit of Rohit, Gagan, and Shalu ⇒ Share profit of Rohit: Share profit of Gagan : Share profit of Shalu ⇒ (1/2)   × 1/2 : (1/3) × 1/4 : (1 – 1/2 -1/3) × 1 ⇒  1/4 : 1/12 : 1/6 ⇒ 3 : 1 : 2 Share of Shalu in profit = 2/6 × 150000 ⇒  Rs. 50000

questions.question: Find the difference between the total number of students studying in Morning shift and in Evening shift.

questions.question: A train of length 549 m traveling at a speed of 70 km/hr crosses 30 poles, with the distance between the two consecutive poles being the same, in 4 min 3 seconds, What is that distance between the two poles?
questions.solution: Solution: Let the distance between two consecutive poles be x Total distance between 30 poles = (30 - 1) x = 29x Total distance train needs to cover to pass 30 poles = 29x + 549 Speed of train = 70 km/hr = 70 × (5/18) = (350/18) m/sec. Time taken to cross poles = total distance/speed of train ⇒ 4 × 60 + 3 = (29x + 549)/(350/18) ⇒ 29x + 549 = 243 × (350/18) ⇒ 29x + 549 = 4725 ⇒ 29x = 4176 ⇒ x = 144 m ∴ Distance between two poles = 144 m

questions.question: The average weight of some animals on a farm is 40 kg when 2 new animals joined the average is increased by 0.5 kg. If the weight of those 2 animals is 45 and 51 kg, find the total number of animals present initially.
questions.solution: Solution: Given: Average of animals = 40 kg Calculation: Let the number of animals = a ⇒ Sum of weight of animals = 40 × a = 40a According to question, 40a + 45 + 51 = (a + 2) × 40.5 ⇒ 0.5a = 15 ⇒ a = 30 ∴ The total number of animals present initially = 30 दिया है: जानवरों का औसत = 40 किग्रा गणना: जानवरों की संख्या = a ⇒ जानवरों के वज़नों का योगफल = 40 × a = 40a प्रश्न के अनुसार, 40a + 45 + 51 = (a + 2) × 40.5 ⇒ 0.5a = 15 &rAr

questions.question: Four years ago, the average age of a group of five members was 38 years. One more man joins the group and the present average age of the group members becomes 44 years. What is the present age (in years) of the new member?
questions.solution: Solution: Given: 4 years ago, The average age of 5 members = 38 years Now, Average of 6 persons = 44 Formula used: Average = sum of the observations/Number of the observations Calculation: Four years ago, The average age of 5 members was 38 ⇒ 38 = sum of age of 5 members/5 Sum of age of 5 members = (38 × 5) = 190 Present age = Age of a person 4 years ago + 4 year ⇒ The sum of current age of 5 members is ⇒ [190 + (4 × 5)] ⇒ (190 + 20) ⇒ 210

questions.question: Speed of bike is 44 km/hr and is travelling against the wind. Another bike whose speed is 53 km/hr is coming with wind. Find the time to meet if distance between them is 339.5 km (in hours)
questions.solution: Solution: Given:- Speed of bike 1 = 44 km/hr Speed of bike 2 = 53 km/hr Distance = 339.5 km Formula:- Distance = speed × time Speed of bike with wind = b + w Speed of bike against wind = b – w Calculation:- Bike speed 1 = 44 – w Bike speed 2 = 53 + w Time required = 339.5/(44 – w + 53 + w) = 3.5 hours. दिया गया है:- बाइक 1 की गति = 44 किमी/घंटा बाइक 2 की गति = 53 किमी/घंटा दूरी = 339.5 किमी सूत्र:- दूरी = गति × समय हवा के साथ बाइक की गति = b + w हवा क

questions.question: P and Q are friends investing in ratio of 2 : 3 in a portfolio. After 9 months P withdraws all his money and at the end of term they receive profits in ratio of 3 : 8. Find the term of investment of Q in months.
questions.solution: Solution: Given: P : Q = 2 : 3 End → P  :Q = 3 : 8 Calculation: Let, term of investment be T and investments of P and Q be 2X and 3X. ⇒ Term of P’s investment = 2X × 9 ⇒ Term of Q’s investment = 3X × T ⇒ (2X × 9) / (3X × T) = 3 / 8 ⇒ 16 = T ⇒ T = 16 months ∴ Term of the investment is 16 months. questions.question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following number series?

25, ?, 30, 9, 35, 11, 40, 13
questions.solution: Solution: Given: 25, ?, 30, 9, 35, 11, 40, 13 Calculation: ⇒ ? =  9 - 2 = 7  ∴ The value of ? is 7 दिया हुआ: 25,?, 30, 9, 35, 11, 40, 13 गणना: ⇒? = 9 - 2 = 7 ∴ ? का मान 7 है।

questions.question:
What should come in place of the question mark '?' in the following number series?

12, ?, 6, 9, 18, 45, 135
questions.solution: Solution: Given: 12, ?, 6, 9, 18, 45, 135 Calculation: 12 × 0.5 = 6 6 × 1 = 6 6 × 1.5 = 9 9 × 2 = 18 18 × 2.5 = 45 45 × 3 = 135 ∴ ? = 6  दिया हुआ है: 12, ?, 6, 9, 18, 45, 135 गणना: 12 × 0.5 =  6 6 × 1 = 6 6 × 1.5 = 9 9 × 2 = 18 18 × 2.5 = 45 45 × 3 = 135 ∴ ? = 6

questions.question:
What should come in the place of the question mark '?' in the following number series?

2400, ?, 30, 5, 1.25, 0.625
questions.solution: Solution: The pattern followed by the series is 2400 ÷ 10 = 240   240 ÷ 8 = 30  30 ÷ 6 = 5  5 ÷ 4 = 1.25 1.25 ÷ 2 = 0.625  श्रंखला में अनुसरित प्रारूप निम्न है:  2400 ÷ 10 = 240   240 ÷ 8 = 30  30 ÷ 6 = 5  5 ÷ 4 = 1.25 1.25 ÷ 2 = 0.625

questions.question:
What should come in the place of the question mark '?' in the following number series?

101, 102, 110, 137, ?, 326
questions.solution: Solution: The pattern followed by the series is 101 + 1 3  = 102 102 + 2 3  = 110 110 + 3 3  = 137 137 + 4 3  = 201 201 + 5 3  = 326 ∴ The required term will be 201 श्रंखला में अनुसरित प्रारूप निम्न है:  101 + 1 3  = 102 102 + 2 3  = 110 110 + 3 3  = 137 137 + 4 3  = 201 201 + 5 3  = 326 अतः आवश्यक पद 201 होगा |
